scripts.title: XD ADMIN V3 (read description)
scripts.script:
local Player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = Player:GetMouse()
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

--  UI SETUP
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
ScreenGui.Name = "AdminUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local function makeDraggable(obj)
	local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
	obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = obj.Position
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			obj.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
	obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
	end)
end

-- MAIN PANEL (SQUARE)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 320) 
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -160)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", MainFrame)
MainStroke.Thickness = 3
makeDraggable(MainFrame)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", MainFrame)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "XD Admin V3"
Title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
Title.TextSize = 24
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- SCROLLING FRAME
local Scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", MainFrame)
Scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -50)
Scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 45)
Scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
Scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
Scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4

local ListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", Scroll)
ListLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
ListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 15)

local Padding = Instance.new("UIPadding", Scroll)
Padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
Padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 15)

-- BUTTON GRID
local GridFrame = Instance.new("Frame", Scroll)
GridFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 130) -- Adjusted height
GridFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local GridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout", GridFrame)
GridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 135, 0, 35)
GridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)

local function createStyledBtn(name, color, parent)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", parent)
	btn.Text = name
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextSize = 13
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	return btn
end

local FlyBtn = createStyledBtn("Fly", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100), GridFrame)
local NoclipBtn = createStyledBtn("Noclip", Color3.fromRGB(180, 100, 255), GridFrame)
local TPBtn = createStyledBtn("Tap TP", Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255), GridFrame)


local ResetBtn = createStyledBtn("Reset", Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), GridFrame)

-- SLIDERS
local function createSlider(name, min, max, default)
	local Holder = Instance.new("Frame", Scroll)
	Holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 45)
	Holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel", Holder)
	Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Label.TextSize = 12
	Label.Text = name .. ": " .. default
	Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

	local SliderFrame = Instance.new("Frame", Holder)
	SliderFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	SliderFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 22)
	SliderFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
	Instance.new("UICorner", SliderFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

	local Bar = Instance.new("Frame", SliderFrame)
	Bar.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 4)
	Bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.5, -2)
	Bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)

	local Dot = Instance.new("TextButton", Bar)
	Dot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
	Dot.Position = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), -8, 0.5, -8)
	Dot.Text = ""
	Dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Instance.new("UICorner", Dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

	local val = default
	local sliding = false
	Dot.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then sliding = true end end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then sliding = false end end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if sliding and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local per = math.clamp((i.Position.X - Bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / Bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
			Dot.Position = UDim2.new(per, -8, 0.5, -8)
			val = math.floor(min + (per * (max-min)))
			Label.Text = name .. ": " .. val
		end
	end)
	return function() return val end
end

local getFlySpeed = createSlider("Fly Speed", 20, 500, 60)
local getSpeed = createSlider("Walk Speed", 16, 500, 16)
local getJumpPower = createSlider("Jump Power", 50, 500, 50)
local getGravity = createSlider("Gravity", 0, 196, 196)

-- PLAYER LIST
local ListTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", Scroll)
ListTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
ListTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ListTitle.Text = "SERVER PLAYERS"
ListTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ListTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
ListTitle.TextSize = 13

local PlayerListFrame = Instance.new("Frame", Scroll)
PlayerListFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 0)
PlayerListFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local PlayerListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", PlayerListFrame)
PlayerListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)

local function updatePlayerList()
	for _, v in pairs(PlayerListFrame:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("Frame") then v:Destroy() end end
	for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= Player then
			local pEntry = Instance.new("Frame", PlayerListFrame)
			pEntry.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
			pEntry.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
			Instance.new("UICorner", pEntry).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

			local pLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", pEntry)
			pLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
			pLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
			pLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			pLabel.Text = p.DisplayName
			pLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
			pLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			pLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			pLabel.TextSize = 11

			local pTP = Instance.new("TextButton", pEntry)
			pTP.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.7, 0)
			pTP.Position = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 0.15, 0)
			pTP.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
			pTP.Text = "TP"
			pTP.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			pTP.TextSize = 10
			Instance.new("UICorner", pTP).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

			pTP.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	PlayerListFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, #Players:GetPlayers() * 40)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(updatePlayerList)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(updatePlayerList)
updatePlayerList()


-- APPLY PLAYER stats
local function applyPlayerSettings()
	local char = Player.Character
	if not char then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		-- Walk Speed
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = getSpeed()

		-- Jump Power
		humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
		humanoid.JumpPower = getJumpPower()
	end

	-- Gravity
	workspace.Gravity = getGravity()
end

local settingsConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if Player.Character then
		applyPlayerSettings()
	end
end)

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
	character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	task.wait(0.1)
	applyPlayerSettings()
end)

-- LOGIC
-- FLY
local flying = false
FlyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	flying = not flying
	FlyBtn.Text = flying and "Fly (ON)" or "Fly"
	local char = Player.Character
	if flying and char then
		local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", hrp)
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", hrp)
		bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		char.Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		task.spawn(function()
			while flying and char.Parent do
				local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local dir = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.LookVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.LookVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir = dir - cam.CFrame.RightVector end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir = dir + cam.CFrame.RightVector end
 -- up & down
	            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then dir = dir + Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then dir = dir - Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
				bv.Velocity = dir.Unit * getFlySpeed()
				if dir == Vector3.new(0,0,0) then bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0) end
				bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
				task.wait()
			end
			bv:Destroy() bg:Destroy() char.Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end)
	end
end)

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	flying = false
	FlyBtn.Text = "Fly"

	task.wait(0.1)

	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hrp then
		for _, v in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("BodyVelocity") or v:IsA("BodyGyro") then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
end)


-- NOCLIP
local noclip = false
local ncConn

local function toggleNoclip(on)
	noclip = on
	NoclipBtn.Text = on and "Noclip (ON)" or "Noclip"

	if ncConn then ncConn:Disconnect() end
	ncConn = nil

	if on then
		ncConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
			if Player.Character then
				for _, v in ipairs(Player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
					if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide = false end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

NoclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	toggleNoclip(not noclip)
end)

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	toggleNoclip(false)
end)

ResetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	toggleNoclip(false)
	if Player.Character then Player.Character:BreakJoints() end
end)

-- Tap TP
local tpOn = false

TPBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	tpOn = not tpOn
	TPBtn.Text = tpOn and "TP (ON)" or "Tap TP"
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if not tpOn or processed then return end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local pos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local ray = workspace.CurrentCamera:ViewportPointToRay(pos.X, pos.Y)
		local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000)

		if hit and Player.Character then
			Player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame =
				CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
		end
	end
end)

-- Reset on death
Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	tpOn = false
	TPBtn.Text = "Tap TP"
end)

ResetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	tpOn = false
	TPBtn.Text = "Tap TP"
	if Player.Character then Player.Character:BreakJoints() end
end)

-- Reset button
ResetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if Player.Character then Player.Character:BreakJoints() end end)

-- X button
local CloseBtn = createStyledBtn("X", Color3.fromRGB(255,50,50), MainFrame)
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 8)
local OpenBtn = createStyledBtn("Open XD", Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), ScreenGui)
OpenBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 40)
OpenBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 0.9, 0)
OpenBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
OpenBtn.Visible = false
makeDraggable(OpenBtn)
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() MainFrame.Visible = false OpenBtn.Visible = true end)
OpenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() MainFrame.Visible = true OpenBtn.Visible = false end)

-- Dynamic Headless, Korblox, Hair & Accessories Hub
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("HeadlessCustomGui") then

local function setHeadless(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")

		local face = head:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
		if face then face.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end
		head.CastShadow = not state
	end
end

local function setKorblox(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	-- Podpora pro R6 i R15
	local rightLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg") or char:FindFirstChild("Right ?")
	local rightFoot = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
	local upperLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")

	if state then
		if upperLeg then upperLeg.Transparency = 1 end
		if rightLeg then rightLeg.Transparency = 1 end
		if rightFoot then rightFoot.Transparency = 1 end
		-- Zmenšení / skrytí spodní části pro korblox efekt
		if char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot") then
			char.RightFoot.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
		end
	else
		if upperLeg then upperLeg.Transparency = 0 end
		if rightLeg then rightLeg.Transparency = 0 end
		if rightFoot then 
			rightFoot.Transparency = 0 
			rightFoot.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
		end
	end
end

local function setHair(state)
	local char = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, item in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Accessory") and item.AccessoryType == Enum.AccessoryType.Hair then
			local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then handle.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Remove versão anterior para evitar duplicações
local guiAntiga = playerGui:FindFirstChild("AnimSpeedGUI")
if guiAntiga then
	guiAntiga:Destroy()
end

-- Tabela para guardar os IDs das animações de andar, correr, pular e idle
local locomotionIds = {}
local ultimaVelocidade = nil

-- Função para mapear as animações do sistema de movimentação do personagem
local function carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	locomotionIds = {}
	local animateScript = character:WaitForChild("Animate", 5)
	if animateScript then
		local pastasMovimento = {"idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "strafe"}
		for _, nomePasta in ipairs(pastasMovimento) do
			local pasta = animateScript:FindFirstChild(nomePasta)
			if pasta then
				for _, obj in ipairs(pasta:GetChildren()) do
					if obj:IsA("Animation") and obj.AnimationId ~= "" then
						locomotionIds[obj.AnimationId] = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Conecta ao personagem para registrar IDs e monitorar novas animações
local function conectarCharacter(character)
	carregarLocomotionIds(character)
	
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if not humanoid then return end
	local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)
	if not animator then return end

	animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
		task.wait(0.05)
		local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
		-- Aplica a velocidade salva caso uma nova animação de emote comece
		if not (animId and locomotionIds[animId]) and ultimaVelocidade then
			track:AdjustSpeed(ultimaVelocidade)
		end
	end)
end

if player.Character then
	conectarCharacter(player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(conectarCharacter)

-- ScreenGui Principal
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "AnimSpeedGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Frame Principal Minimalista
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "AnimSpeedFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 140)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.4, 0)

mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local frameCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
frameCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
frameCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local frameStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
frameStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
frameStroke.Thickness = 1
frameStroke.Parent = mainFrame

-- Título
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Name = "Title"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Velocidade do emote"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = mainFrame

-- Caixa de Entrada (TextBox)
local inputBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
inputBox.Name = "InputBox"
inputBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 35)
inputBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.28, 0)
inputBox.PlaceholderText = "Digite a velocidade..."
inputBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
inputBox.Text = ""
inputBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
inputBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
inputBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
inputBox.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
inputBox.TextSize = 15
inputBox.Parent = mainFrame

local inputCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
inputCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
inputCorner.Parent = inputBox

-- Permite APENAS números no campo de texto
inputBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	local textoFiltrado = inputBox.Text:gsub("[^%d.]", "")
	if inputBox.Text ~= textoFiltrado then
		inputBox.Text = textoFiltrado
	end
end)

-- Botão Submit (Aplicar)
local submitButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
submitButton.Name = "SubmitButton"
submitButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 35)
submitButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.62, 0)
submitButton.Text = "Aplicar"
submitButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)
submitButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
submitButton.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
submitButton.TextSize = 16
submitButton.AutoButtonColor = true
submitButton.Parent = mainFrame

local buttonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
buttonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
buttonCorner.Parent = submitButton

-- Função para alterar a velocidade dos emotes tocando no momento
local function setAnimSpeed(speed)
	if not speed then return end
	ultimaVelocidade = speed

	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			if animator then
				for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
					local animId = track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId
					-- Altera a velocidade APENAS se não for uma animação do Animate script (idle/walk/run/jump)
					if not (animId and locomotionIds[animId]) then
						track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Função disparada para aplicar a alteração
local function aplicarMudanca()
	local speed = tonumber(inputBox.Text)
	if speed then
		setAnimSpeed(speed)
	end
end

-- Clique no botão de Aplicar
submitButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(aplicarMudanca)
scripts.features:
🚀 EMOTE SPEED GUI V2 🚀

Um painel simples e direto para controlar a velocidade dos seus emotes no Roblox. Sem enrolação, sem interface gigante — só o essencial funcionando.

⚡ COMO FUNCIONA
• Abra o painel e digite a velocidade desejada (aceita apenas números).
• Clique em "Aplicar" e o emote que estiver tocando será acelerado ou desacelerado na hora.

🎭 INTELIGENTE
• Altera SOMENTE os emotes (danças, gestos, etc).
• Animações de movimento (andar, correr, pular, idle) continuam normais — não afeta sua movimentação.
• Se você trocar de emote depois, a velocidade configurada é reaplicada automaticamente.

🛡️ ESTÁVEL
• Funciona mesmo após respawn (não perde a configuração enquanto o script estiver rodando).
• Remove versões antigas do painel ao executar de novo — sem duplicações.
• Leve e otimizado, sem travamentos.

🎨 INTERFACE
• Painel pequeno e compacto (230x140).
• Arrastável — coloque onde quiser na tela.
• Campo numérico que bloqueia letras automaticamente.
• Design limpo com fonte estilizada.

📱 COMPATÍVEL COM DELTA EXECUTOR

🔥 Simples, funcional e sem bugs. Teste agora!

scripts.title: Legit Hub Best R6 n R15 aimbot and ESP
scripts.features:
1. Visual Enhancements (ESP)
Allows you to see other players through walls and obstacles. You can display their names, health bars, equipped tools, and draw boxes or skeletons around them. It also features off-screen indicators that draw arrows on the edge of your screen pointing toward hidden enemies.
2. Combat Assistance
Aimbot: Automatically adjusts your camera to lock onto enemies. It includes options for smooth movement, target prediction for moving players, and a visual field-of-view circle.
Triggerbot: Automatically simulates a mouse click to shoot the exact moment your crosshair hovers over a valid target.
3. Player Modifications
Grants your character superhuman physical abilities. You can increase your walking speed, jump much higher, fly freely, walk through solid objects (Noclip), gain infinite health (God Mode), or expand the invisible hitboxes of enemies to make them easier to hit.
4. World and Environment
Lets you alter the game's visual settings. You can remove all darkness and shadows (Fullbright), remove or customize fog, change the time of day, and activate an "FPS Boost" that simplifies graphics to improve performance on slower devices.
5. Cosmetics and Utilities
Includes a fully customizable crosshair, a spinning neon "China Hat" accessory for your character, an Anti-AFK feature to prevent the game from kicking you for being idle, and a small watermark displaying your real-time FPS and ping.
6. Interface and Protection
All features are controlled via a modern, draggable menu. You can save and load custom configuration profiles, assign keyboard shortcuts for quick access, and use a player list to whitelist or blacklist specific users. Additionally, it features an Anti-Kick system designed to block the game from removing you from the server.
